why_ai: A risk-bearing balance sheet, appointed-actuary sign-off and judgement on impaired risks protect the core, while new-business, service and valuation processing on screens is exposed.
why_clarity: Classes, reserves and service transactions are well defined and recur by the thousand, but whether a mortality judgement was right is known only a decade or more later.
why_digital: Applications, medical records and models are digital work on screens; many policies are still bought through agents and advisers in person.

why_ai: Accelerated programmes absorb simple cases, but the accountable underwriter's class on impaired, high-face cases stays judgement-heavy.
why_clarity: Risk classes are defined by a manual and repeat at volume, but mortality confirms or refutes them years later.
why_digital: Evidence arrives as data and documents and is worked on screens; applications still come through producers.

why_ai: Data-driven triage on third-party data is exactly what models already do; the human role is monitoring.
why_clarity: Programmes run thousands of near-identical decisions with written rules, checked only through small audited samples.
why_digital: Data feeds in, automated decisions out, inside digital application flows.

why_ai: Reading the medical file is automatable, but weighing ambiguous, interacting impairments is the expert's personal, slow-feedback judgement.
why_clarity: Underwriters weigh the same file differently and mortality reveals errors years later.
why_digital: Faxed and scanned records read on screens; retrieval still depends on physicians' offices.

why_ai: Credentialed actuaries must sign reserves and opinions under statute, though runs, attribution and memos automate.
why_clarity: Reserves follow written rules on a fixed calendar and reconcile objectively each quarter.
why_digital: Data, models and filings entirely on screens; consultants and auditors are engaged through relationships.

why_ai: Recalculating contract values and converting code are machine-readable tasks once the rules are extracted.
why_clarity: Every policy value either reconciles to the contract or does not, across thousands of near-identical policies.
why_digital: Legacy data and code worked on screens; conversions are bought as large programmes through relationships.

why_ai: Capacity and return-to-work judgements on contested medical evidence carry ERISA exposure and stay human.
why_clarity: Claims recur in large numbers under policy definitions, but recovery outcomes resolve over months or years.
why_digital: Medical records and decisions are documents worked on screens, with phone contact and occasional in-person exams.

why_ai: The appointed actuary's personal opinion and the board's trust in a small team protect the function; the calculations automate.
why_clarity: The statutory calendar is a fixed, checkable list of deliverables that recurs every year.
why_digital: Models and filings are digital; small carriers buy from consultants they know personally.

why_ai: Matching and search are data work AI does well; contacting families and resolving entitlement keeps some human role.
why_clarity: A beneficiary is found and paid or not, within state-defined search rules, across many similar cases.
why_digital: Records and searches are digital, but outreach still runs through mail and phone.

why_ai: Checking files against a written best-interest rule is rule-bound document review that AI can triage.
why_clarity: Each file is reviewed against the same elements at volume, with examiner findings as a delayed check.
why_digital: Electronic applications and forms reviewed on screens.

why_ai: Validating and processing standard service requests is the most mechanical work in the industry.
why_clarity: Each request is in good order or not under explicit rules, thousands of times a day.
why_digital: Forms arrive by upload and mail and are processed digitally.

why_ai: Physician-underwriter judgement on individual medical files and licensed providers protect it, though rules-based LEs are spreading.
why_clarity: Every LE is a defined estimate made at volume, but deaths confirm it years later.
why_digital: Medical records in, LE reports out, sold remotely to investors and providers.

why_ai: Licensed data assets are durable, but the scoring itself is machine work.
why_clarity: Scores are defined products validated against mortality, computed per applicant at volume.
why_digital: Data licensed and delivered as API reports to carriers.

why_ai: A pooled cross-carrier dataset is a moat AI cannot generate; the analysis itself is routine.
why_clarity: Annual studies follow a set method, but behaviour assumptions are tested only as experience emerges.
why_digital: Policy data in, studies out, all delivered remotely to participating carriers.

why_ai: Credentialed actuaries sign opinions and carry personal professional liability on reserves and appraisals.
why_clarity: Statutory work follows standards and recurs annually, but whether reserves were adequate is known years later.
why_digital: Client data and models worked on screens and delivered as reports, with senior relationships.

why_ai: Medical-director judgement and cedents' trust in the reinsurer's manual sustain it; rule maintenance automates.
why_clarity: Manual ratings follow written methods, but their mortality accuracy shows only over decades.
why_digital: Research and manuals are digital; treaty relationships run through meetings.

why_ai: Regulatory prescription and calibration reputation protect a small quant product.
why_clarity: Calibrations recur for each valuation date against defined targets, though tail realism is untestable.
why_digital: Market data in, scenario files and software out, delivered online.

why_ai: Reading public statutory filings is what AI does well; trusted names carry the distribution decision.
why_clarity: Quarterly carrier reviews repeat, but distress calls are confirmed only by rare downgrades.
why_digital: Public filings in, research reports out, sold remotely.

why_ai: Member data and industry authority keep the association's series; survey analysis automates.
why_clarity: Quarterly surveys and studies recur on a set method with defined outputs.
why_digital: Member data and publications are digital; membership relationships matter.

why_ai: An expert must personally testify and withstand cross-examination in adversarial, high-stakes cases.
why_clarity: Each case is bespoke and the verdict, not the method, decides what counted.
why_digital: Case data analysed on screens; testimony and retention are in person through counsel.

why_ai: Vendor landscapes and survey analysis are substitutable by AI research tools; analyst access is the residual.
why_clarity: Advice quality is subjective and its payoff is unobservable.
why_digital: Surveys and reports delivered online; inquiry calls are remote.

why_ai: Bespoke, irreversible block bids on uncertain long-term experience are high-stakes judgement.
why_clarity: Each deal is unique and its success is known decades later.
why_digital: Data rooms worked on screens; deals negotiated through relationships.

why_ai: Statutory authority over solvency cannot be delegated; demand grows with complex products and reinsurance.
why_clarity: Reviews follow handbooks, but examination outcomes are judgement calls revealed slowly.
why_digital: Filings are digital, but exams happen on site and carriers cannot choose their regulator.

why_ai: The member exchange is a durable utility; checking and coding are mechanical.
why_clarity: Each check is a defined lookup repeated millions of times.
why_digital: Codes in, checks out, through automated member connections.

why_ai: Professional authority over tables used in regulation protects the research.
why_clarity: Experience studies follow a codified method, but tables are validated only as experience emerges.
why_digital: Data and publications are digital and freely distributed.

why_ai: Advocacy depends on standing and relationships with legislators, not analysis.
why_clarity: Policy wins are political and slow to judge.
why_digital: Publications are digital; advocacy runs through meetings and hearings.

why_ai: Software maintenance is engineering work that AI coding tools accelerate; client lock-in protects revenue.
why_clarity: Model libraries implement written regulations and are tested against known results.
why_digital: Software built and delivered digitally to carriers.

why_ai: Producer relationships and carrier contacts protect placement work; case shopping automates.
why_clarity: Placement recurs with clear offers, though best-offer quality is partly judgement.
why_digital: Case files and offers are digital; producer relationships are personal.

why_ai: Hands-on specimen collection is physical, but data-driven underwriting is replacing the exam itself.
why_clarity: Exams and interviews follow a fixed protocol with objective lab results.
why_digital: Bodies and specimens in, digital results out, contracted nationally by carriers.
